dropped.item: The explicit claim "It isn't cheaper" (the post-editing job is not actually a cheaper version of the work). It is only partly implied by the later "same liability" and "saved no effort" lines.
"still" in "then still rewriting whatever I can't trust": the nuance that rewriting remains necessary even after the double reading is softened.

changed.item: The original says the offer is made "as if that were a discount on the real work", an implied framing. The edit says "They present it as a discount on the real work", which attributes an explicit framing to the agency.
